note: Issue #920 — the twenty domains the LLM Mentions pilot asks about. The fixture's rivals are IANA reserved names (rival-one.example.net and friends) and cannot be queried, so the list is real domains chosen to span the range ReachKit sells into. There is no paying site to add yet; when there is, put it in the small-business tier and drop one of the listicle picks. The small-business domains are real US local-service sites taken from a public roundup of local-business websites, which is the closest public stand-in for a ReachKit customer.

tiers.saas: Well known, heavily written about. These should return rows; if they do not, the database is thinner than the sales page claims.
tiers.small-saas: Real products with real users but a fraction of the press. The interesting middle.
tiers.small-business: US local service businesses — what ReachKit actually sells to. This tier is the question.
tiers.non-us: Outside the US. ChatGPT data is US/English only, so these measure what a non-US customer would see.
